notes.title: NoClip's "How Games are Made" Series featuring Everbloom (Episode 1 & 2)
notes.content:
[p]We were lucky enough to partner with NoClip to document all the development of Everbloom. The first two episodes are out now![/p][p][/p][p]In episode one we dive into everything audio related: music, sound effects, speech. We cover the tech and creative aspects.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/lbOghip5CPI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Episode two is all about trees. It seems like a small thing, but we had some unique challenges for Everbloom.
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/1EaMz6WLZN4"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 100,000 Wishlists! Thank you!
notes.content:
We’ve hit an incredible milestone, 100,000 wishlists on Steam! Thank you for all your support. We are thrilled by the love and support of our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139028/81f8d6521976b464720607a585b6177d0aaffae4.png[/img]

We're working hard to make the game the best version it can be. New characters, crops, locations, and exciting features in the works.

We recently held our first closed playtest, and it was a huge success! Players had an incredible time exploring, farming, and bonding with the woodland characters of Everbloom. We're now working hard on getting ready for our next larger closed playtest. If you haven't already, be sure to visit our Discord to stay updated!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F4f3pNPMK7X]Everbloom Discord[/url]

notes.title: 50,000 wishlists! Thank you!!!
notes.content:
Thank you for all the support. In less than one month Everbloom has reached 50k wishlists. Your support means the world to us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139028/e8087c559637d24c2967ed47e3b373784762f295.png[/img]

notes.title: Steamdeck Support
notes.content:
Will Everbloom support the Steamdeck?

We are going to do our best to make sure the game runs great on the Steamdeck. The game is already running on device and we'll continue to have it part of our normal testing loop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139028/cb5fa5055463710f4f1dd6748ee0500e74982679.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank You for 25k Wishlists in just one week!
notes.content:
We are blown away by the love for Everbloom! We can't thank you enough. Your support means the world to us.
